title: Thermo Fisher Patches Flaw That Could Make DNA File Tampering Nearly Undetectable
summary: Thermo Fisher Scientific has patched a flaw in select Applied Biosystems human identification software that could allow data files to be altered before analysis software loads them.

title: N-able Says Attackers Take Over N-central Servers After Initial Fix Proves Incomplete
summary: N-able said attackers exploited an authentication bypass in N-central to gain remote administrative access and reach the customer systems managed through those servers.

title: Hugging Face Diffusers Flaws Could Let Model Repositories Execute Arbitrary Code
summary: Three high-severity security flaws have been disclosed in Hugging Face's Diffusers library that could allow crafted model repositories to stealthily execute arbitrary code on machines that load it, opening the artificial intelligence (AI) supply chain to security risk.
